facts.text: Aman Kyoto is set in a secret garden in a forest, a stone's throw from Kinkaku-ji Temple.
facts.excerpt: Set in a secret garden at the heart of a forest, Aman Kyoto rests a stone’s throw from Kyoto’s golden Kinkaku-ji Temple

facts.text: The Golden Pavilion (Kinkakuji), a UNESCO World Heritage Site, is within walking distance of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Iconic UNESCO World Heritage Site the Golden Pavilion (Kinkakuji) is also within walking distance

facts.text: The pavilions were designed by Kerry Hill Architects in a minimalist style.
facts.excerpt: the perfectly-measured minimalist design of the pavilions by Kerry Hill Architects

facts.text: Aman Kyoto was Kerry Hill's last project before he passed away.
facts.excerpt: As longtime collaborator Kerry Hill’s last project before he passed away

facts.text: The grounds include a moss garden dedicated to the late designer Kerry Hill.
facts.excerpt: a deeply peaceful jewel-green moss garden dedicated to the late designer

facts.text: Rooms have a very large hinoki bathtub.
facts.excerpt: A key highlight? The vast hinoki bathtub—big enough to fit an entire family (forward planning is required

facts.text: Each afternoon, guests are invited to a bowl of premium matcha with seasonal sweets.
facts.excerpt: Each afternoon, hotel guests are invited to savour a bowl of premium matcha accompanied by seasonal sweets.

facts.text: Guests are offered complimentary evening aperitifs, from Champagne and wine to sparkling sake.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in nightly complimentary evening aperitifs, with a choice ranging from Champagne and wine to sparkling sake.

facts.text: Taka-an is the hotel's second restaurant, offering a modern kaiseki experience at a long wooden counter.
facts.excerpt: Taka-an, which offers a expertly executed modern kaiseki experience at a long wooden counter

facts.text: The Japanese breakfast offers a choice of Kuroge Wagyu beef or grilled fish with clay pot rice or soymilk porridge.
facts.excerpt: a choice of Kuroge Wagyu beef or grilled fish is served with clay pot rice or soymilk porridge

facts.text: The spa has outdoor and indoor onsen hot spring bathing facilities.
facts.excerpt: Outdoor and indoor onsen hot spring bathing facilities

facts.text: The spa has three private treatment rooms.
Electric bicycles are available for exploring the neighbourhood's lanes.
facts.excerpt: electric biycles are available for exploring the neighbourhood’s tranquil lanes

facts.text: A guided tour of the secret garden is offered to guests.
facts.excerpt: Guided tour of Aman Kyoto's secret garden

facts.text: Children's activities include origami and acorn and leaf hunting art sessions, and kids menus are available.
facts.excerpt: Children will love the gardens as well as activities (from origami to acorn and leaf hunting art sessions) while kids menus are also available.

facts.text: The hotel is not ideal for guests who want all the sights on their doorstep.
facts.excerpt: It’s not going to be the perfect setting for those who prefer all the sites right on their doorstep

facts.text: The paths are uneven stone, but several rooms close to the entrance are designed for wider accessibility.
facts.excerpt: several rooms close to the entrance are specially designed for wider accessibility
